title: A Study of Rofecoxib in Familial Adenomatous Polyposis (FAP) (0966-205)(TERMINATED)
brief_summary: A study to evaluate rofecoxib in the treatment of rectal, colon, or duodenal adenomas in patients with Familial Adenomatous Polyposis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Males or females at least 18 years of age with familial adenomatous polyposis.
